description: Natural-language requests to harvest lessons from past sessions route to the lessons skill's mine mode; an in-the-moment correction routes to the same skill's capture mode.

cases.prompt: mine lessons from the last week
what did we learn this sprint?
harvest lessons from our recent sessions
no, not like that — use the other approach
cases.note: an in-the-moment correction is lessons capture mode, fired by the skill's own trigger rather than a /mtk keyword

expected.rationale: Requests to sweep/harvest past sessions for durable lessons map to lessons mine mode; an in-the-moment redirect maps to lessons capture mode. Both modes live in one skill after the consolidation.
